scripts.compact: node ../../../../tooling/scripts/ensure-compact-package-aliases.mjs && node ../../../../tooling/scripts/ensure-compact-artifacts.mjs --manifest src/managed/.compact-artifact.json --source-root src --output src/managed/mixed-claims-credential -- compact compile src/mixed-claims-credential.compact src/managed/mixed-claims-credential && node ./scripts/align-runtime-version.mjs && node ./scripts/strip-managed-sourcemaps.mjs
